key.name: show-button
key.description: Determines if the TextGrabber button appears in the top bar.

key.name: textgrabber-shortcut
key.description: Shortcut to trigger the TextGrabber action.

key.name: tesseract-languages
key.description: Languages used by Tesseract for OCR.

key.name: ocr-engine
key.description: Engine used for OCR: Tesseract, EasyOCR or both (the longest result is kept).

key.name: read-codes
key.description: When the selected area contains a QR code or a barcode, its content is copied instead of the text. Requires zbar (zbarimg).

key.name: join-lines
key.description: Removes the line breaks inside a paragraph of the recognized text and joins the words cut with a hyphen. Empty lines between paragraphs and list items are kept.
